programme.desc: The most famous cheese made in the high plateau of La Mancha is Manchego. Will and Ellie visit several farms that still make raw milk Manchego using traditional methods. From the high plains of La Mancha, Will and Ellie head north west into the spectacular Pico's de Europa mountains to find Cabrales, the most famous Spanish Blue cheese. programme.desc: The most famous cheese made in the high plateau of La Mancha is Manchego. Will and Ellie visit several farms that still make raw milk Manchego using traditional methods. From the high plains of La Mancha, Will and Ellie head north west into the spectacular Pico's de Europa mountains to find Cabrales, the most famous Spanish Blue cheese. The way this distinctive blue cheese is made and matured has hardly changed in thousands of years and there are now only about forty artisan and farmhouse producers remaining. programme.desc: The most famous cheese made in the high plateau of La Mancha is Manchego. Will and Ellie visit several farms that still make raw milk Manchego using traditional methods. From the high plains of La Mancha, Will and Ellie head north west into the spectacular Pico's de Europa mountains to find Cabrales, the most famous Spanish Blue cheese. programme.sub-title: Cheeses Of La Mancha And Cabrales
programme.desc: The most famous cheese made in the high plateau of La Mancha is Manchego. Will and Ellie visit several farms that still make raw milk Manchego using traditional methods. From the high plains of La Mancha, Will and Ellie head north west into the spectacular Pico's de Europa mountains to find Cabrales, the most famous Spanish Blue cheese. The way this distinctive blue cheese is made and matured has hardly changed in thousands of years and there are now only about forty artisan and farmhouse producers remaining. Will and Ellie visit a local home dairy to see how the cheese is made and then tour one of the rustic maturation caves hidden in the mountains surrounding the village.

programme.sub-title: Cheeses Of La Mancha And Cabrales
programme.desc: The most famous cheese made in the high plateau of La Mancha is Manchego. Will and Ellie visit several farms that still make raw milk Manchego using traditional methods. From the high plains of La Mancha, Will and Ellie head north west into the spectacular Pico's de Europa mountains to find Cabrales, the most famous Spanish Blue cheese. The way this distinctive blue cheese is made and matured has hardly changed in thousands of years and there are now only about forty artisan and farmhouse producers remaining. Will and Ellie visit a local home dairy to see how the cheese is made and then tour one of the rustic maturation caves hidden in the mountains surrounding the village.

programme.desc: The most famous cheese made in the high plateau of La Mancha is Manchego. Will and Ellie visit several farms that still make raw milk Manchego using traditional methods. From the high plains of La Mancha, Will and Ellie head north west into the spectacular Pico's de Europa mountains to find Cabrales, the most famous Spanish Blue cheese. The way this distinctive blue cheese is made and matured has hardly changed in thousands of years and there are now only about forty artisan and farmhouse producers remaining. Will and Ellie visit a local home dairy to see how the cheese is made and then tour one of the rustic maturation caves hidden in the mountains surrounding the village.

programme.desc: The most famous cheese made in the high plateau of La Mancha is Manchego. Will and Ellie visit several farms that still make raw milk Manchego using traditional methods. Will and Ellie visit a local home dairy to see how the cheese is made and then tour one of the rustic maturation caves hidden in the mountains surrounding the village.

programme.sub-title: Cheeses Of La Mancha And Cabrales
programme.desc: The most famous cheese made in the high plateau of La Mancha is Manchego. Will and Ellie visit several farms that still make raw milk Manchego using traditional methods. From the high plains of La Mancha, Will and Ellie head north west into the spectacular Pico's de Europa mountains to find Cabrales, the most famous Spanish Blue cheese. The way this distinctive blue cheese is made and matured has hardly changed in thousands of years and there are now only about forty artisan and farmhouse producers remaining. Will and Ellie visit a local home dairy to see how the cheese is made and then tour one of the rustic maturation caves hidden in the mountains surrounding the village.

programme.desc: The most famous cheese made in the high plateau of La Mancha is Manchego. Will and Ellie visit several farms that still make raw milk Manchego using traditional methods. From the high plains of La Mancha, Will and Ellie head north west into the spectacular Pico's de Europa mountains to find Cabrales, the most famous Spanish Blue cheese. programme.sub-title: Cheeses Of La Mancha And Cabrales
programme.desc: The most famous cheese made in the high plateau of La Mancha is Manchego. Will and Ellie visit several farms that still make raw milk Manchego using traditional methods. From the high plains of La Mancha, Will and Ellie head north west into the spectacular Pico's de Europa mountains to find Cabrales, the most famous Spanish Blue cheese. The way this distinctive blue cheese is made and matured has hardly changed in thousands of years and there are now only about forty artisan and farmhouse producers remaining. Will and Ellie visit a local home dairy to see how the cheese is made and then tour one of the rustic maturation caves hidden in the mountains surrounding the village.

programme.desc: The most famous cheese made in the high plateau of La Mancha is Manchego. Will and Ellie visit several farms that still make raw milk Manchego using traditional methods. From the high plains of La Mancha, Will and Ellie head north west into the spectacular Pico's de Europa mountains to find Cabrales, the most famous Spanish Blue cheese.
